messages:
Ava Patel: Heads-up — noticed preview card showing a steady climb in 'estimated tokens' for several EU tenants after we rolled out sticky-routing yesterday :confused:
Ava Patel: looks correlated with route-hash stickiness + our preview sampling change
Diego M.: sticky hashing was intended to reduce cross-shard churn, did we also change fallback order?
Kira Zhou: fallback unchanged, but sticky routing means more requests stay on a slower proxy until its kv cache warms, so preview might see different kv-state than finalizer
Ava Patel: here's a quick query I ran to compare preview vs ledger token counts by route:
```
SELECT route_id, SUM(preview_tokens) preview, SUM(final_tokens) ledger
FROM billing.preview_vs_ledger
WHERE window='2025-07-12'
GROUP BY route_id
ORDER BY preview - ledger DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Ava Patel: several routes show preview > ledger by ~2-8% concentrated on routes with low cache hit rates
Rohan: that points to transient dedupe/eviction behavior. preview is sampling prefix tokens aggressively; finalizer uses full KV to attach session tokens -> mismatch
Kira Zhou: can we add a per-route cache_hit metric to the preview card? product wants a one-glance explanation for customers when preview is 'estimated'
Diego M.: +1. also suggest the console show the routing policy version used for preview so support can correlate to rollout windows
Ava Patel: UX ask from product: add an orange "estimated" badge and tooltip that explains "estimate may differ from final invoice due to routing and late-attribution" :information_source:
metering-bot: anomaly detected: ROUTE-STICKY-HEAT > threshold for tenants [eu-11, eu-77]. Created ticket MTR-HEAT-2025-07-12
OpsBot: deploy note: sticky-routing v3.4 rolled to canary at 2025-07-11T22:00Z; full rollout started 2025-07-12T01:00Z
Diego M.: propose mitigations: 1) add preview route-version and cache_hit metrics 2) throttle how many preview frames we accept from a single route in 30s 3) implement conservative attribution for routes with cache_hit < 40%
Kira Zhou: mitigation 3 feels safest for UX. we can mark those preview rows as "low confidence" and exclude them from the preview aggregate by default (toggleable)
Rohan: telemetry change: emit `preview_confidence` tag with values [high, low, tentative] and increment `preview_to_ledger_delta` counter per tenant+route
Ava Patel: engineering rollout plan: ship telemetry + console badge in streaming-preview v1.2; enable conservative attribution behind feature flag for 48h canary on EU routes only
Diego M.: QA: create E2E that replays a burst with sticky routing enabled, assert preview_diff_pct < 3% when conservative attribution is on
Kira Zhou: will update console mock and copy for the tooltip. product wants a small banner in billing UI for affected tenants during the canary window
metering-bot: feature-flag created: preview_conservative_attr -> enabled for eu-11, eu-77 at 2025-07-13T04:00Z
Ava Patel: schedule canary: streaming-preview v1.2 -> EU shadow plane at 2025-07-13T08:00Z. Rohan please monitor preview_vs_ledger dashboard and surface any tenants >5% delta
Rohan: on it. also capturing sample traces (req_id) from preview rows so we can reconcile to finalizer logs. sample log format we added:
```
PREVIEW_TRACE req=0x3fA2 route=eu-west-2 cache_hit=27% preview_tokens=420
FINALIZER_TRACE req=0x3fA2 route=eu-west-2 final_tokens=412 attribution=primary
```
Diego M.: if conservative attr reduces preview volume too much we may need a middle ground: keep tokens in preview but tag them until finalizer confirms (delayed confirmation flow)
Kira Zhou: noted. product prefers tag-with-confirmation over outright exclusion if possible
Ava Patel: action items: Diego -> implement telemetry counters + feature flag toggle; Rohan -> dashboard watchlist + trace link; Kira -> console badge copy + mock; QA -> E2E replay test. We'll reconvene after 24h canary
metering-bot: watch created: preview_vs_ledger-eu-canary (alert if tenant delta > 5% for 1h)
Ava Patel: thanks team. keeping this thread as the rollout coordination channel. Ping me if we need to pause the rollouts :thumbsup:
